name: Ciclo Novos Talentos do Jazz:Orquestra Jazz Matosinhos &Juan Saus Ruiz
description: Saxophonist Juan Saus Ruiz joins the Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos for a concert featuring big band compositions.
longDescription:
The Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos welcomes Spanish alto saxophonist and composer Juan Saus Ruiz for this concert in the Ciclo Novos Talentos do Jazz. Under the musical direction of Daniel Dias, the orchestra performs arrangements from Saus Ruiz's big band project alongside works by composers including Bob Brookmeyer, Gil Evans, Maria Schneider, Guillermo Klein and Oliver Nelson.

The concert takes place at Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery in Matosinhos on 5 December 2026. Standard tickets cost 7,50 euros, with reduced admission available at 5 euros for students and seniors.
